decision_for_reviewer: WriteIRem is not a new extension class but a split of WriteIDiv (a0c7714525b6, NFC). Marking it unsupported (as the task text suggested for new classes) would have changed REM scheduling on Mempool, so it was given WriteIDiv's exact resources/latency, as upstream's split commit did for every existing model (reference RISCVSchedSyntacoreSCR1.td:59-62 at llvmorg-19.1.7). WriteIRem32 marked unsupported alongside the already-unsupported WriteIDiv32. Zabha/Xsfvcp/Zvk marked unsupported via upstream multiclasses as in RISCVSchedRocket.td:254,264,265. RISCVSchedSnitch.td defines no WriteRes, so it produces no errors and is unchanged.
